title: API reference
content_data:
> **Important**
> By using Events API endpoints, you agree to the [TikTok Business Products (Data) Terms](https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/policy/business-products-terms) and that you will not share sensitive data with TikTok. Events API consists of three endpoint groups: App Events, Pixel Events (Web Events), and Offline Events endpoints. # App Events API > **Note**
Events API - App is currently in Beta. If you'd like to use this API, please contact your TikTok representative. Your accounts need to be allowlisted before you can report events using [/v1.3/app/track/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?rid=oyn7lhbo6ar&id=1740859196043266) or [/v1.3/app/batch/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?rid=oyn7lhbo6ar&id=1740859218541569). * [Report an App Event](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740859196043266) * [Report App Events in bulk](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740859218541569) * [Get info of an app](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740859272887297) * [Create an app](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740859280958466) * [Update an app](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740859300069378) * [Get the app list](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740859313270786) * [Get App Conversion Events](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740859338750977) * [Get App Retargeting Events](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740859371033601) # Pixel Events API * [Report a Web Event](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740858531237890) * [Report Web Events in bulk](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740858565852225) * [Get pixels](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740858697598978) * [Create a pixel](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740858779758593) * [Update a pixel](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740858799524865) * [Create Pixel Events](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740858807646209) * [Update a Pixel Event](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740858823774210) * [Delete a Pixel Event](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740858862104578) * [Get Instant Page events](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740898639412226) * [Get Pixel Event statistics](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740858904557570) # Offline Events API * [Create an Offline Event set](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1758427576470529) * [Update an Offline Event set](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1765596741157889) * [Delete an Offline Event set](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1765596790860802) * [Get Offline Event sets](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1765596808589313) * [Report an Offline Event](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1758428013689857) * [Report Offline Events in Bulk](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1758428053652482) # CRM Events API * [Get CRM Event Sets](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1780896521680898) - [Create a CRM Event Set](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1858830704718658)
